I loved this app so much, I say lovED because as of a recent update barely any of the songs are available to learn for free and it makes you go to another one of their apps, where you basically have to pay for everything. reviews.title: Trash
reviews.text: I’ve used guitar turners for a while now and this since gained an ear for a tuned guitar. However, i appreciate the extra validation that comes with something or someone else says that this is a tuned guitar. However, while trying to tune my b string (mind you the app “recommends headphones” even for tuning and I used with and without headphones) I just couldn’t get the tune anywhere close to right. It ultimately ended with a snapped string and I am highly upset about it. I would never recommend this app to my friends especially the almost $00 a year subscription. NEVER PAY FOR THIS!!! If you want to pay for a legitimate guitar tuner/trainer, I would highly recommend “GuitarTuna”, they are actually a decent yearly price, a legitimate company, and don’t end in snap strings

reviews.title: Missing help for ukulele
reviews.text: I have a low G on my ukulele, but I can’t find any settings that I could change in simply tune to choose low G instead of high G.  So I tried to search help, but website took me only to simply piano—not the right app.  And there’s no way to contact support to ask a question.  So, “Simply” is not so simple after all.   Also, I chose ukulele on the first screen, but I was fed questions about guitar (like I got a question asking can I already play these chords? but they were showing guitar chords, not ukulele).  Once through the set up, I had to again choose ukulele.  It defaults to guitar.  Not so “simple” if you’re learning ukulele.

reviews.title: Would NOT recommend
reviews.text:
One star, and that’s being generous.

I downloaded this tuner to do one simple thing: tune my guitar. Instead, it helped me snap a string. The app constantly told me I was wildly out of tune when I clearly wasn’t, so I kept tightening like it said… and snap. Thanks for that.

On top of that, it almost never picks up the notes I’m actually playing. I can strum the same string over and over and the app either shows the wrong note, jumps all over the place, or just sits there like it can’t hear anything. I tried different rooms, different volumes, and even another guitar. Same problem every time.

If you enjoy broken strings and a tuner that doesn’t recognize notes, this app is perfect. Otherwise, save yourself the frustration and look elsewhere.
